fields.title: Hepatitis B
fields.description: A viral infection that attacks the liver and can become chronic, leading to liver failure or cancer.

fields.title: Tuberculosis
fields.description: A bacterial infection mainly affecting the lungs but can involve other organs; it can be severe or fatal.

fields.title: Measles, Mumps, Rubella (MMR)
fields.description: Viral infections. Measles: highly contagious with possible complications. Mumps: swelling of salivary glands and possible complications. Rubella: generally mild except in pregnancy, where it can cause serious birth defects.

fields.title: Diphtheria, Tetanus
fields.description: Diphtheria: causes a thick covering in throat, can block airways and cause complications. Tetanus: causes severe muscle spasms, often fatal if untreated.

fields.title: Pertussis (Whooping cough)
fields.description: A highly contagious respiratory disease causing violent coughing fits, dangerous for infants.

fields.title: Poliomyelitis (Polio)
fields.description: A viral disease that can cause paralysis and even death if breathing muscles are affected.

fields.title: Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) infection
fields.description: A bacterial infection that can cause meningitis, pneumonia, and other serious illnesses, especially in children.
